title: Authentication and session security
preconditions: Future authentication service; unused email; two browser sessions.
steps: Register a reader with valid email and password.
Reject duplicate email and wrong password.
Sign in, capture session, then sign out.
Retry protected request with old session (verify invalidation).
expected: Registration succeeds; passwords securely hashed; sign-out cleanly drops session.

title: Edit profile and retain community reviews
steps: Save display name "Alice A" and bio "Bio".
Read Alice's profile and check reviews.
expected: Name and bio update; review remains visible; blank name rejected.

title: Search queries (Valid and Empty)
expected: Valid search returns book details. Unmatched returns empty state. Whitespace returns all catalog items.

title: Shelf lifecycle and privacy boundaries
steps: Add b1 to Want to Read.
Switch to second user and remove b1.
expected: Only one primary status remains for User 1. User 2 removing their copy doesn't affect User 1's copy.

title: Progress calculations and validation
expected: Percentages calculate correctly (0, 50, 100). Invalid inputs are rejected without losing previously saved data.

title: Review creation, editing, and authorization
steps: Switch user and attempt to edit/delete the first user's review.
expected: Owner can edit/delete successfully. Non-owner actions are strictly rejected.

title: Book-specific threads and replies
expected: b1 contains thread and reply with author, parent and timestamp; b2 contains neither.

title: Spoilers hidden until explicit reveal
steps: Read it with the post ID explicitly revealed.
expected: Hidden view contains no spoiler text; explicit reveal returns text; new view defaults to hidden.

title: Render untrusted review text safely (XSS)
steps: Save review text containing an injected script.
Inspect rendered DOM and window execution marker.
expected: Injected script tags are rendered literally; browser execution marker is never fired.

title: Data persistence and error handling
expected: Saved data survives reboot. Errors throw cleanly but do not corrupt in-memory or previously saved disk state.
